    23	#define DNS__16BIT(p)  ((unsigned short)((unsigned int) 0xffff & \

    28	 * Macro DNS__32BIT reads a network long (32 bit) given in network
    29	 * byte order, and returns its value as an unsigned int.
    30	 */
    31	#define DNS__32BIT(p)  ((unsigned int) \
    32	                         (((unsigned int)((unsigned char)(p)[0]) << 24U) | \
    33	                          ((unsigned int)((unsigned char)(p)[1]) << 16U) | \
    34	                          ((unsigned int)((unsigned char)(p)[2]) <<  8U) | \
    35	                          ((unsigned int)((unsigned char)(p)[3]))))

    39	#define DNS__SET32BIT(p, v)  (((p)[0] = (unsigned char)(((v) >> 24) & 0xff)), \

    41	                              ((p)[2] = (unsigned char)(((v) >> 8) & 0xff)), \
